AcceptInvitationRequest.description: The invitation token is the credential that opens the account.
AcceptInvitationRequest.title: AcceptInvitationRequest

AcceptInvitationResponse.description:
The account and first session one accepted invitation produced.

``session_token`` is the secret the new account presents as
``X-Session-ID``; it is never stored, only its digest.
AcceptInvitationResponse.title: AcceptInvitationResponse

AdminUpdateUserRequest.description: The administrator-writable fields of one account.
AdminUpdateUserRequest.title: AdminUpdateUserRequest

ApprovalDecisionRequest.description: One decision; the idempotency key makes its retry replayable.
ApprovalDecisionRequest.title: ApprovalDecisionRequest

ApprovalRequestView.description: One approval request; the presented status derives expiry.
ApprovalRequestView.title: ApprovalRequestView

AssetRef.description:
One content-addressed input asset of a run.

The destination is a safe relative path inside the execution
environment: the shared path validator rejects absolute paths, parent
segments and backslashes, and the transfer resolves containment
against the environment root before writing.
AssetRef.title: AssetRef

AuditAppendView.description: The receipt of one extension append; a replayed key reports no new fact.
AuditAppendView.title: AuditAppendView

AuditEventPage.description: One cursor page of audit events ordered by occurrence sequence.
AuditEventPage.title: AuditEventPage

AuditEventView.description: One sanitized audit fact with its database-assigned occurrence sequence.
AuditEventView.title: AuditEventView

AvailableModelConnectionView.description: The user's selectable model subset; no upstream address or secret.
AvailableModelConnectionView.title: AvailableModelConnectionView

CapabilityDefinitionView.description: One definition as the catalog exposes it; content lives in versions.
CapabilityDefinitionView.title: CapabilityDefinitionView

CapabilityVersionView.description: One immutable-or-draft version with its full declared content.
CapabilityVersionView.title: CapabilityVersionView

ChannelConfiguration.description:
The vendor protocol one channel definition speaks.

A channel declares one vendor protocol and the adapter operations
that speak it. The declaration is static: an entrypoint is an
identifier the package must carry as a declared resource, and no
vendor client is constructed, no signature is verified and no
message is exchanged at publish time.
ChannelConfiguration.title: ChannelConfiguration

ChannelOperation.description: One adapter operation with its identifier and typed I/O schemas.
ChannelOperation.title: ChannelOperation

DefinitionInput.description: Common definition metadata; the discriminated declaration chooses its type.
DefinitionInput.title: DefinitionInput

DraftInput.description: Complete static draft input; publishing freezes this validated content.
DraftInput.title: DraftInput

ExtensionAuditAppend.description: One extension-reported fact; actor and scope come from the verified call.
ExtensionAuditAppend.title: ExtensionAuditAppend

ExtensionConfiguration.description:
The export contract one extension definition publishes.

An extension declares the exports its package installs with — typed
operations with their effects, hooks bound to fixed stages, and event
consumers — plus the permissions those exports need. The declaration
is frozen at publish; nothing is imported, registered or run here.
ExtensionConfiguration.title: ExtensionConfiguration

ExtensionEvent.description: One declared event consumer with its operation and idempotency fields.
ExtensionEvent.title: ExtensionEvent

ExtensionHook.description: One declared hook bound to fixed stages with a failure policy.
ExtensionHook.title: ExtensionHook

ExtensionOperation.description: One declared operation: typed I/O, effects, timeout and permissions.
ExtensionOperation.title: ExtensionOperation

FlowExecutionPolicy.description: Published effects policy; retries resume receipts without resubmitting children.
FlowExecutionPolicy.title: FlowExecutionPolicy

HistoryAppendRequest.description: The items one append stores, in order.
HistoryAppendRequest.title: HistoryAppendRequest

HistoryAppendView.description: How many items the append stored.
HistoryAppendView.title: HistoryAppendView

HistoryItemView.description: The item one pop removed, or nothing when the history was empty.
HistoryItemView.title: HistoryItemView

HistoryPage.description: One bounded read of the native history, oldest first.
HistoryPage.title: HistoryPage

InvitationIssueView.description: The newly issued token is returned only once to its administrator.
InvitationIssueView.title: InvitationIssueView

InvitationView.description: One invitation; the presented status derives expiry, never rewrites it.
InvitationView.title: InvitationView

McpToolDeclaration.description: One advertised tool with its parameter schema; discovery is runtime.
McpToolDeclaration.title: McpToolDeclaration

NormalizedUsage.description: Quantity-only operation usage; input tokens exclude the cached bucket.
NormalizedUsage.title: NormalizedUsage

OutputDeclaration.description:
One declared execution output: a safe relative path and its media type.

The path is where a run may write back inside the granted workspace;
it is validated as a safe relative path again in the service, because
a persisted declaration is later resolved against a storage root.
OutputDeclaration.title: OutputDeclaration

QuotaLimitsRequest.description: The administrator-writable allowances of one account.
QuotaLimitsRequest.title: QuotaLimitsRequest

QuotaView.description: One account's limits and current ledger position.
QuotaView.title: QuotaView

SessionCreateRequest.description: The scope a new session is opened in; the user scope is the default.
SessionCreateRequest.title: SessionCreateRequest

SessionGrant.description:
A session grant returned by registration and login.

``session_token`` is the secret the client presents as ``X-Session-ID``;
it is shown once here and never stored, so a database leak alone cannot
authenticate. The public row id appears in the session listings.
SessionGrant.title: SessionGrant

ToolOperation.description: One callable operation with its schemas, effects and approval demand.
ToolOperation.title: ToolOperation

UpdateDefinitionRequest.description: The definition-level metadata an author may change.
UpdateDefinitionRequest.title: UpdateDefinitionRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description: The fields an account may change on its own profile.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UserProfileView.description: One account profile; avatar bytes are fetched from their own route.
UserProfileView.title: UserProfileView

post.description: Revoke the presenting session; the identity channel stays available.
Open an account and return its first session.

get.description: List personal accounts by default, or accounts in one authorized exact scope.
Liveness never touches a dependency and is safe for process probes.
Readiness verifies DB, Redis and the native Temporal service.

post.description: Issue one pending invitation for the administrator to deliver.
Accept one invitation with its token; no session exists before acceptance.
Issue a replacement token; the previous token stops working.
Open one model session in the requested scope.

delete.description: Delete one closed model session together with its native history.

get.description: Read one model session of the current principal.

post.description: Close one model session, draining behind its active runs.

get.description: Read the native history of one visible session, oldest first.

post.description: Clear the native history of one open session.
Append items to the native history of one open session.
Remove and return the newest history item of one open session.

get.description: The requests assigned to the current subject.
One cursor page ordered by occurrence sequence; filters are ANDed.

post.description: Append one extension-reported fact under the verified invocation scope.

get.description: One page-free listing of the reader's own artifacts.

post.description: Create one user directory at a validated relative path.

get.description: Download the current version's verified bytes.

put.description: Store one new version, optionally under a compare-and-set expectation.
